content.user_title: Add LocalBusiness Schema From Your Google Listing
content.value_statement: Website business details can differ from a Google listing, making structured data harder to maintain. This skill builds JSON-LD from available listing fields and proposes an exact website diff for approval.
actual_capabilities: Select a connected business location and read its profile through Reach MCP.
Choose a specific schema.org business subtype from the primary category, with LocalBusiness as the fallback.
Map available name, phone, website, address, hours, and description into JSON-LD without inventing missing fields.
Serialize JSON-LD safely and escape less-than signs before embedding it in an HTML script tag.
Locate website layouts, check existing JSON-LD blocks, and propose an exact diff before editing.
Compare website hours, phone, and address with listing values and request approval for each correction.
limitations: Requires a connected Reach MCP server, browser OAuth sign-in, and an active Google listing connection.
Cannot write to Google Business Profile through this skill.
Uses returned profile data only; missing fields and unknown freshness must remain explicit.
Does not guarantee search visibility or automatic validation; it suggests external tools for owner review.

use_cases.title: Integrate Schema Into a Website Layout
use_cases.description: Locate the shared layout, inspect existing JSON-LD, and update structured data using safe serialization.

use_cases.title: Compare Public Business Details
use_cases.description: Review differences between website contact details and Google listing values before requesting specific corrections.

prompt_templates.title: Draft LocalBusiness Schema
prompt_templates.prompt: Create LocalBusiness JSON-LD from my connected Google listing. Explain the selected type and missing fields. Do not edit files yet.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: review a first schema draft.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Website Diff
prompt_templates.prompt: Read my listing and inspect this website repository. Find existing JSON-LD and propose an exact schema diff. Wait for approval before editing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: integrate structured data into a website.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Website and Listing Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare website hours, phone, and address with my selected Google listing. Show differences in a table and ask which values are correct.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Schema Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect existing JSON-LD against my selected listing. Check subtype, missing fields, duplicates, and safe serialization. Propose an exact diff and await approval.

output_examples.input: Draft schema for my connected dental practice listing before changing the website.
output: Selected type: Dentist, matching the listing category.
Included the available business name, phone, website, address, hours, and description.
Omitted unavailable ratings, images, and coordinates.

output_examples.input: The listing phone differs from the website phone. Compare them before making changes.
output: The comparison identifies different phone values in the website and Google listing.
Owner confirmation is required to determine the correct value.
The website correction requires approval of the exact line change.

best_practices: Confirm the correct location, active connection, returned limitations, and data freshness before generating schema.
Review the exact diff and resolve each business-detail discrepancy before approving edits.
Use safe JSON serialization, update existing schema instead of duplicating it, and verify the resulting page.
anti_patterns: Inventing ratings, images, coordinates, price ranges, or other fields absent from the listing.
Embedding raw listing text directly into HTML or leaving script-tag termination sequences unescaped.
Approving broad changes without reviewing the exact diff or assuming this skill updates the Google listing.

faq.question: What must I connect before using this skill?
faq.answer: Connect Reach MCP in your AI client, sign in through browser OAuth, and ensure the selected Google listing connection is active.

faq.question: Does this skill change my Google listing?
faq.answer: No. It reads listing data and edits website files only after you approve the exact diff.

faq.question: What happens when my account has multiple locations?
faq.answer: The skill asks which location to use before reading its profile.

faq.question: How does it handle missing listing information?
faq.answer: It omits missing fields, reports limitations, and does not invent ratings, images, coordinates, or other unsupported values.

faq.question: Will it add duplicate structured data?
faq.answer: The workflow checks existing JSON-LD blocks and updates one instead of adding a duplicate.

faq.question: Does it guarantee rich search results?
faq.answer: No. It prepares structured data and suggests validation tools, but it does not guarantee search visibility or rich results.
